score.description: Confidence between 0 and 1, if the model gives one.

Event.title: Event

Media.description: Technical data of the audio file.

speech_duration.description: Seconds of speech after voice activity detection.

sample_rate.description: Samples per second of the decoded audio.
sample_rate.title: Sample Rate

max_dbfs.description: Loudest sample in dBFS, null for silent audio.
max_dbfs.title: Max Dbfs

rms.description: Root mean square of the samples.
rms.title: Rms

ModelInfo.description: Which backend and model produced a step, and the versions of the Python packages it used.

model.description: Model the backend used, if it has one.
model.title: Model

ModelInfo.title: ModelInfo

Speaker.description: A speaker and when they talk.

id.description: Speaker label. The gold label name (for example alice) if the speaker was matched to a gold label clip, otherwise the diarizer label (for example sprecher_0). Only unique inside one result, not across episodes.
id.title: Id

segments.description: Time ranges this speaker talks, sorted by start.
segments.title: Segments

Speaker.title: Speaker

TimeRange.description: Seconds from the start of the audio file.
TimeRange.title: TimeRange

TranscriptEntity.description: A named entity found in the transcript. Not filled yet, planned for a later MAT version.

start.description: Seconds from the start of the audio file.
start.title: Start

end.description: Seconds from the start of the audio file.
end.title: End

TranscriptEntity.title: TranscriptEntity

Word.description: A word or, in segments, several words of the same speakers merged into one line.

start.description: Seconds from the start of the audio file, null if unknown.
start.title: Start

end.description: Seconds from the start of the audio file, null if unknown.
end.title: End

speakers.description: Speaker ids talking during this word. Empty if nobody matched, more than one if speakers overlap.
speakers.title: Speakers

Word.title: Word

models.description: Step name (transcriber, diarizer, identifier, summarizer) to the backend that ran it. Steps that were skipped are missing.
models.title: Models

language.description: Detected language as ISO 639-1 code, for example de.
language.title: Language

speakers.description: Speakers after matching them to gold label clips. This is the list to use.
speakers.title: Speakers

diarization.description: Speakers as the diarizer found them, before matching.
diarization.title: Diarization

segments.description: Consecutive words with the same speakers merged into lines.
segments.title: Segments

summary.description: Summary as Markdown, null if the summary was skipped or failed.
summary.title: Summary
